runtime.execution: Bun direct TypeScript; no independent typecheck
runtime.note: the fail-closed runner gates the complete retained source/dist closure before execution

SC-DOC-07.union-member-order-is-source-o.question: is emitted union member order canonical, or the source arrangement?
SC-DOC-07.union-member-order-is-source-o.verdict: member order is the SOURCE order; the same member SET emits different bytes

SC-DOC-07.object-property-order-is-sourc.verdict: propertySignatures order is the SOURCE order

SC-DOC-07.node-key-order-IS-normalised.question: is the KEY order inside one representation node normalised?
SC-DOC-07.node-key-order-IS-normalised.verdict: YES — node key order follows the codec struct field order, not the input

SC-DOC-07.references-table-key-order-is-.question: does the references table preserve authored key order?
SC-DOC-07.references-table-key-order-is-.verdict: NO — the table is a JS object, so integer-like keys sort numerically ahead of insertion order. encode(decode(bytes)) != bytes.

E4-SCHEMA-CE-012.duplicate-references-ke.verdict: last duplicate wins, silently, at JSON.parse — before Effect sees the value

E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.literal-number-leg-refu.observedBuild: THREW Error: A numeric literal must be finite, got NaN
E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.literal-number-leg-refu.observedWireLiveNaN: THREW SchemaError: Expected a finite number |   at ["representation"]["literal"]["value"]
E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.literal-number-leg-refu.verdict: the Literal number leg is Finite; NaN is refused at BUILD and at the WIRE, and the string escape hatch is NOT accepted there

E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.enum-value-DOES-carry-n.verdict: YES — a non-finite number reaches a persisted enum value, encoded as one of exactly three tagged STRINGS under type "number". `Schema.Json` does not block it.

E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.property-key-DOES-carry.verdict: YES — a persisted property key can be NaN, via the same three-string escape

E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.third-numeric-domain-ch.observed: THREW RangeError: Expected a finite number, got Infinity
E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.third-numeric-domain-ch.verdict: a THIRD numeric domain the ruling does not name: a check payload number must be finite, enforced by a host RangeError, not a SchemaError

E4-SCHEMA-CE-023.negative-zero-does-not-.verdict: -0 survives the live document but JSON.stringify writes 0, so the sign is lost at the byte face

E4-SCHEMA-CE-011.annotation-pruning.verdict: pruning is per-ENTRY and whole-tree: one non-JSON leaf drops the whole entry, silently, with no issue; when nothing survives the `annotations` key is omitted, never emitted as {}

E4-SCHEMA-CE-010.local-symbol-fails-at-l.observedEmit: THREW SchemaError: cannot serialize to string, Symbol is not registered
E4-SCHEMA-CE-010.local-symbol-fails-at-l.verdict: a local symbol builds a live schema and fails only at lowering; the refusal is a SchemaError, not a type error

degenerate.verdicts.Suspend carrying a check: THREW SchemaError: Expected no excess property
degenerate.verdicts.empty $ref: THREW SchemaError: Expected a value with a length of at least 1
degenerate.verdicts.verdict: empty union / object / tuple / enum / template-literal parts / references table are all ACCEPTED and emit an empty collection; a zero-member FilterGroup, an empty $ref, a Suspend with a check, a Declaration or Filter without `representation`, and an empty MultiDocument root list are all REFUSED; excess keys are dropped silently
